title: Pyramids built during the Saharan Humid Period

tellings.quote: I think they were built by the civilization that lived in Egypt during a period known as the Saharan Humid Period, which is from 8,500 BC to around 5,300 BC.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey Drum told podcast host Jesse Michels that he thinks the pyramids of Egypt were built by a civilization living there during the Saharan Humid Period, a time when the region was much wetter, which he dates from about 8,500 BC to about 5,300 BC. If true, it would make the pyramids thousands of years older than usually believed.
